user.title: Shinybow SB-8804LCM
user.description: Select the matrix serial port, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/. Uses 9600 8N1 without flow control. State is assumed until feedback is verified.

reconfigure.description: Select the matrix serial port, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/. Uses 9600 8N1 without flow control. State is assumed until feedback is verified.

error.invalid_config: Enter a name and an absolute /dev/ serial device path.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: Name inputs and outputs
init.description: Assign names to the eight inputs and outputs. Blank names use the default. Input names must be unique and cannot be Off. Saving reloads the integration; assumed routing states become unknown until another command is sent.

error.duplicate_input_names: Use distinct input names (ignoring capitalization). Off is reserved for turning outputs off.
